tx:
▸ Pylon
One of the uses is for charging the pylon found in the main fortress level. Adding pylon batteries to the pylon awards Archaeology experience based on level, each battery also contributing 0.001% charge to the pylon across all worlds up to 100% (up to 100,000 batteries in total) for a temporary buff to all players that lasts for 30 minutes. A maximum of 10,000 batteries can be handed in at once. Handing in 10–99 batteries at once will award 10% extra experience and 0.011% charge, and handing in 100 or more batteries at once will award 20% extra experience and 0.12% charge.
▸ Pylon boost
When the pylon is charged to 100%, everyone in Kharid-et on all worlds is given the opportunity to receive pieces of the Inquisitor staff when excavating from any excavation or cache node in the main and prison area of the fortress for 30 minutes. The drop rate of staff pieces are further increased when excavating in the praetorium.
While the pylon is active, batteries are unobtainable but can still be turned in for experience. Doing so does not extend the duration of the pylon's activation effects nor will it provide charge after the pylon's buff effect has ended. Therefore, it is best to wait until after the event has ended to turn in pylon batteries.
▸ Shadow anchors
Another use is for activating shadow anchors. Ten batteries are used to charge each of the eight shadow anchors permanently in Kharid-et, requiring a total of 80 batteries to charge all of them. These can be used instead of a fully charged pylon to complete The Vault of Shadows.
• Six anchors in the main fortress area
• Two anchors inside the chapel (which requires the pontifex signet ring and level 58 Archaeology to enter)

The following actions will give a chance to drop this pet:
• smelting bars or corrupted ore
• smithing bars into weapons and armour
• doing the burial equipment or ceremonial swords activities at the Artisans' Workshop
• capping at the Furnace in a Clan Citadel
• casting the Superheat Item spell 
• creating explosive effigies
• creating foil
The following actions will not give a chance to drop this pet:
• Using protean bars or unstable protean bars
• Playing a Minigame that rewards experience in this skill

Gaining this item is based on the amount of experience awarded at once; the more experience granted per item made, the greater the chance of gaining this pet. The chance is not affected by experience boosters.
In a purely mathematical format, the chance f of receiving the pet on any particular action is
f = \frac{(B / 20) \times S}{50,000,000}
Where:
• B is the base experience per action
• S is the virtual skill level. At 200 million experience, a flat bonus of 200 is applied to this value
